Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 6. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The following Additional Terms & Conditions shall form an integral part of the Bid Document and shall be r ead in conjunction with the GeM General Terms & Conditions (GTC), Category Specifications and other bid conditions. In case of any inconsistency, the provisions of GeM GTC and the applicable Category Specificati ons shall prevail. 1. OEM Authorisation The bidder shall upload a Bid Specific Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF)/OEM Authorization Certificate clearly mentioning the GeM Bid Number and authorising the bid der to participate in the subject bid. 2. Supply of Genuine Products All products supplied shall be new, unu sed, factory-manufactured, factory-sealed and genuine OEM products. Supply of refurbished, repaired, rec onditioned, counterfeit or grey-market products shall not be accepted. 3. Factory Configuration The suppli ed equipment shall be delivered in its original factory configuration. No alteration, replacement or modific ation of any factory-fitted component shall be permitted prior to delivery. 4. Product Verification At the tim e of delivery, the successful bidder shall provide: � OEM Warranty Certificate; � Product Serial Number(s); � Product/Part Number(s); and � Model details. The Buyer/Consignee shall be able to verify the product co nfiguration through the OEM’s official website using the supplied serial number. 5. Warranty Warranty shall be provided through the OEM’s authorised service support system. Warranty status shall be verifiable through the OEM website or authorised customer support. 6. Operating System Where applicable , the operating system shall be factory preloaded, genuine and properly licensed in accordance with the ap plicable licensing requirements. 7. Declaration of Authenticity The successful bidder shall submit an under taking confirming that: � all supplied products are genuine OEM products; � products are sourced through

authorised distribution channels; and � all warranty obligations shall be honoured by the OEM. 8. Service S upport The bidder shall provide complete details of the service support facility and escalation matrix available for warranty support within the State of West Bengal, along with contact details of responsible se rvice personnel. 9. End-of-Life Status The quoted model shall not be declared End-of-Life (EOL) or End-of-S upport (EOS) by the OEM as on the date of bid submission. 10. Statutory Compliance The OEM and bidder s hall comply with all applicable statutory requirements, including EPR (where applicable), BIS certification ( where applicable), and all notifications issued by the Government of India and other competent authorities . 11. Inspection and Acceptance Before issuance of the Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRA C), the Buyer/Consignee reserves the right to verify: � physical condition of the product; � serial number; � configuration; � warranty status; and � conformity with the specifications of the GeM bid. 12. Rejection of Supply If any supplied item is found to be counterfeit, refurbished, tampered with, materially different fro m the quoted configuration, or not covered under the OEM warranty, the Buyer reserves the right to reject the supply, recover any payments made (if applicable), and take action in accordance with the GeM Gener al Terms & Conditions and other applicable rules. 13. Submission of Documents All certificates, declaration s and documentary evidence required under the Bid Document, ATC and any corrigendum shall be upload ed with the bid. Failure to furnish the required documents may result in rejection of the bid. .
